name: Qingdao Hi-Tech Moulds & Plastics Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Qingdao Hi-Tech Moulds & Plastics Technology Co., Ltd., based in Qingdao, China, is an enterprise focused on the development, production, and sale of plastic injection molds specifically for the automotive industry. Their comprehensive product portfolio includes various interior components. Specifically, they provide tooling for instrument panels (IP), covering items like upper and lower dashboard bodies, defrosting ducts, defrosting grills, and specialized paladin dashboards. Additionally, their offerings extend to console systems, encompassing the main console, its base, and complete console assembly products. They also produce molds for door panels and their associated assemblies. Furthermore, the company develops tooling for pillar components, including both lower and upper pillar sections, alongside glove boxes. The company was established in 2003 and continues to operate from its Qingdao headquarters.
